scope: existing-registry reconciliation of Manager-global Hub-owned input into exact registered per-instance inboxes

properties.name: claim_survives_source_loss_before_publication
properties.fault: remove original global source immediately after atomic claim and before target publication
properties.expected: the claimed exact payload remains durable and discoverable; failure cannot remove the claim merely because the original global path no longer exists

properties.name: claim_survives_source_mutation_equivalent
properties.fault: replace the original source pathname after claim with different bytes before publication
properties.expected: claim identity derives from claimed bytes, not the newly occupied source pathname; the exact claim remains durable and no wrong bytes are published or used for cleanup

properties.name: claimed_bytes_validate_before_target_resolution
properties.fault: claim a recognized filename whose payload is invalid or lacks canonical instance_id
properties.expected: validation fails closed while the durable claim remains recoverable; active selection or friendly name cannot choose a target

properties.name: unknown_or_ambiguous_instance_fails_closed
properties.fault: claim validates to an instance_id that resolves to zero or multiple authoritative registry rows
properties.expected: no destination publication occurs; claim is retained; no active or unrelated registered instance receives the artifact

properties.name: registry_target_revalidated_at_commit_boundary
properties.fault: change the authoritative registry target path or identity relationship after claim validation but before publication
properties.expected: publication fails closed against stale target information and the exact claim remains durable

properties.name: different_destination_collision_never_overwrites
properties.fault: occupy exact per-instance destination with different or unverifiable bytes before publication
properties.expected: destination is not overwritten and exact claim remains durable for explicit recovery

properties.name: same_exact_destination_is_idempotent
properties.fault: restart with a durable claim whose exact validated artifact is already present at the exact instance-bound destination
properties.expected: destination is verified as exact completed publication; claim may be retired only after verification; no duplicate or destructive rewrite occurs

properties.name: postcommit_verification_failure_preserves_destination_and_claim_marker
properties.fault: inject failure after atomic claim-to-destination move but before successful final verification/claim retirement
properties.expected: destination is preserved, claim metadata remains discoverable as post-commit/ambiguous state, and no destructive rollback is attempted

properties.name: later_artifact_failure_preserves_prior_completed_handoff
properties.fault: complete one exact handoff, then make a later independent artifact invalid or fail before its publication
properties.expected: earlier destination remains authoritative and exact; current failed claim/unprocessed global input remains blocking; prior handoff is not rolled back

properties.name: restart_discovers_and_resumes_claim
properties.fault: terminate between durable claim creation and final claim retirement, then invoke InitializeInstanceRegistry again
properties.expected: restart discovers the durable claim deterministically and resumes/reconciles it before reporting clean initialization

properties.name: doctor_and_hub_operations_surface_unresolved_claim
properties.fault: leave a durable unresolved claim with otherwise healthy registry/active Hub state
properties.expected: Doctor explicitly reports the claim and ordinary Hub-bound update/candidate operations fail closed until reconciliation; Manager-global operations remain governed independently
